title: 42 km yalangoyoq yugurib oltin olgan sportchi kim?

scenes.text: 1960 yilda Rim Olimpiadasida Abebe Bikila 42 kilometrlik marafonni yalangoyoq yugurdi.
U terma jamoaga oxirgi paytda, jarohat olgan sportchi o'rniga kirgan edi.
Unga berilgan poyabzal oyog'iga to'g'ri kelmadi, shuning uchun yalangoyoq chiqdi.
Bikila marraga birinchi keldi va Efiopiyaga ilk olimpiya oltinini olib keldi.
To'rt yildan keyin Tokioda yana g'olib bo'ldi. Bu safar poyabzalda.

description:
Abebe Bikila 1960 yil Rim Olimpiadasida marafonni yalangoyoq yugurib, 2:15:16.2 natija bilan g'olib bo'lgan. U jamoaga jarohat olgan sportchi o'rniga kirgan, berilgan poyabzal oyog'iga to'g'ri kelmagan. Bu Efiopiyaning birinchi olimpiya oltini edi. 1964 yilda Tokioda poyabzalda yana g'olib bo'lgan.

Sizni nima to'xtata olmaydi? Izohda bitta so'z bilan yozing.
source: Wikipedia: Abebe Bikila (won the 1960 Rome Olympic marathon barefoot in 2:15:16.2; late replacement for the injured Wami Biratu; the shoes supplied did not fit; first Ethiopian Olympic champion; won again at Tokyo 1964 wearing shoes) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abebe_Bikila ; Olympics.com: Abebe Bikila.
